title: Tizen Community Package manifest
description: One file per app under packages/. Compiled into repos-build.json / repos-sync.json by scripts/build-manifests.sh.

name.description: Display name shown in the README table. No '|' or newlines.

description.description: One-line description for the README table. No '|' or newlines.

category.description: Catalog category, shown as a filter in Apps2Samsung. media = media-server clients and local players (Jellyfin, Plex, Kodi, music, photos, USB/DLNA); iptv = IPTV and live TV; streaming = clients for streaming services and sites (YouTube, Twitch, Kick, anime, Nuvio, Stremio); games = games, emulators and game streaming; casting = casting receivers and camera viewers; tools = browsers, loaders, network and system utilities; other = anything else.

group.description: Optional. Display name of the app this package is a variant of. Packages sharing a group fold into one Apps2Samsung entry with a variant picker (the Moonlight forks all set "Moonlight"). Required on every manifest of a repo that has more than one. A package with several assets[] folds by itself: its group defaults to its name.

variant.description: Optional. Label for this package's file in the variant picker when it belongs to a group (e.g. "OneLiberty · Chrome"). Single-file packages only; with assets[] put variant on each asset. Defaults to the file name without extension.

repo.description: owner/repo on the forge named by host (GitHub by default). Used as the manifest key, the README link, and (for build/release) the API target. One manifest per repo and source: a second manifest for the same repo (e.g. a native .tpk from its releases beside a web app built from source) must use another source, share the first one's group, and be named owner__repo__<suffix>.json.

host.description: Forge that hosts repo. Defaults to github. gitlab (gitlab.com) is currently supported for source: build only.

repo_label.description: Optional link text for the README Repository column. Defaults to the repo owner.

enabled.description: Set to false to retire the package without deleting this file: it is skipped by the sync (not built, downloaded, or shipped in the release) and left out of the README table. Absent means true.

reason.description: Why the app left the catalogue. Apps2Samsung and TV-Store show their own translated text for it. unlicensed-content = ships streams, playlists or scrapers for content it has no licence for; unlicensed-service = a client for a service that has no licence for its content; unlicensed-game-data = ships commercial game data it may not redistribute; takedown = removed after a copyright (DMCA) notice; superseded = replaced by another app in the catalogue; upstream-gone = the developer removed or archived the project.

note.description: Optional. One neutral line of detail shown under the reason (English only). Never a link to the app or where to get it.

removed.description: Optional, only with enabled: false. Tells users why the app is gone: catalog.json lists it under removed (not apps), so Apps2Samsung and TV-Store can flag an installed copy and answer a search for it. A retired package without this block disappears silently, as before.

adult.description: Set to true for an app whose content is for adults only (18+): pornography or other sexually explicit material. The package ships like any other, but catalog.json carries adult: true on each of its files so Apps2Samsung hides it until the user turns on the 18+ toggle, and the README lists it in a collapsed section instead of the main table. Absent means false. Independent of category: an adult app still gets the category that says what it is (a media-server client, an IPTV player).

source.description: build = compiled from source with Tizen Studio; release = prebuilt .wgt from GitHub Releases; direct = downloaded from a fixed URL.

project_path.description: build only. Subdirectory containing the Tizen web project. Defaults to ".".

pre_build.description: build only. Shell command run before packaging.

overlay.description: build only. Name of a directory under apps/ whose contents are copied over the project before packaging (e.g. a config.xml the upstream doesn't ship).

url.description: direct only. Absolute URL to the .wgt.

output_name.description: Filename inside the bundle. Required unless using assets[].

release_tag_prefix.description: release only. For a monorepo whose Tizen build is released under its own tags (e.g. "smart-tv-v" for smart-tv-v0.7.0) while GitHub's "latest" points at another component. Use the newest stable release whose tag starts with this prefix (a prerelease only if none is stable) instead of /releases/latest. Absent means the usual latest, then newest prerelease.

extract.description: release/direct only. The downloaded asset is a zip wrapper; extract the entry matching this exact name or regex and use that as the package. Use when upstream ships the .wgt inside a .zip.

assets.description: release only. Use when one release contains multiple .wgt files.

match.description: Exact asset name or a regex matched against release asset names.

variant.description: Optional. Label for this file in the Apps2Samsung variant picker (e.g. "Tizen 8"). Defaults to output_name without extension.

extract.description: This asset is a zip wrapper; extract the entry matching this exact name or regex.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the repository key's DER public key, as repo-validate.py prints it.

moved_to.description: Optional. The app now lives in an independent repository (docs/repositories.md). Copied onto each of the package's files in catalog.json; Apps2Samsung offers users who have the app installed to add that repository, with this fingerprint approved by the official catalog. Set it for a notice period before setting enabled to false.

cert_level.description: Optional. The Samsung certificate level the app needs to work: "partner" for an app that uses partner-level rights (DRM playback, Samsung sign-in, a VPN) or hooks into a Samsung native package and so fails at launch when signed with a Public certificate. Apps2Samsung and TV-Store then sign it with the user's Partner certificate. Copied onto each of the package's files in catalog.json. Defaults to "public".

flags.description: Optional. Properties Apps2Samsung shows or warns about (see packages/README.md, What we accept). root = the package gains root on the TV and runs a service from boot; after install the user sets Developer Mode Host PC IP to 127.0.0.1 and restarts, which locks every PC (Apps2Samsung included) out of SDB until it is set back. closed-source = the app's source isn't in the linked repository; accepted because the author grants redistribution. Apps2Samsung shows a Closed source badge. self-updating = the app downloads and runs newer code after install, outside the catalogue and its scan; only allowed from the same repository or author, or from the upstream project the app is built on and names in its description. Apps2Samsung shows a Self-updating badge and a note in the app details. Copied onto each of the package's files in catalog.json.

user_settings.description: Optional. Values the user supplies before install (e.g. a per-user API key, a port). Apps2Samsung asks for them and writes them into the package before re-signing. Two forms, not mixed: file + find/replace on every field (one file), or targets on every field and no file (several files). Copied into catalog.json.

help_url.description: Page that explains where to get the values. Shown as a link above the form.

file.description: Path of the file to patch, relative to the package root (for build, relative to project_path). Required when the fields use find/replace, absent when they use targets.

key.description: Stable id; Apps2Samsung stores the value under it per app.

type.description: number = digits only, written as-is; text = written with quotes and backslashes escaped.

pattern.description: Optional regex the value must match.

default.description: Optional. Written instead when the field is not required and the user leaves it empty, so every find is always replaced. Must itself pass the field's own checks.

min.description: number only. Smallest accepted value, inclusive.

max.description: number only. Largest accepted value, inclusive.

disallow.description: number only. Values the form rejects (e.g. ports the TV itself uses).

find.description: Exact text in file that is replaced. The install fails if it is missing.

targets.description: Every place the value goes, when it lands in more than one spot or file. All are applied; the install fails if any find is missing. Used instead of file + find/replace.

find.description: Exact text in file that is replaced.

package_path.description: Path inside the package, relative to its root (for build, relative to project_path). No leading / and no ..

replace.description: Replacement text; {value} is the user's value.
